title: Heart-Shaped Box
author: Joe Hill
summary: An ageing rock star who collects macabre objects buys a dead man's suit online. It arrives with a ghost that has a grudge, and he and his girlfriend are pulled into a road trip to the truth.
readIf: you like horror with a fast pace, a music-world setting and a very direct ghost.

pairings.reason: By the author's father, with a similar fondness for flawed leads and haunted objects or places.
Another story of a past event that comes back to hunt the people responsible.
